table.name: TLGNR_SAP_VEHICLE_TYPE_BS
table.description: Vehicle type data, table of SAP to LOGON vehicle type mappings. Is updated manually with tablebrowser if SAP type codes change.

column.name: LOGON_VEHICLE_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_logon_vehicle_type_bs. Logon vehicle type (truck, trailer, ...).

column.name: TRUCK_TRANSPORT_CAT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_truck_transport_cat_bs. E.g. Silo, Container, Auflieger. Logic: Silo -> Bulk transport, trailer and container need to be null. Container -> Container transport, trailer needs to be null, container needs to be set. Trailer: Trailer needs to be set, container is null, TRUCK_TYPE_CD needs to be semi-trailer.

column.name: TRUCK_TRANSPORT_CAT_CD_M_FLAG
column.description: Truck transport category mandatory flag: Can the transport category be changed manually in LOGON truck master data or has it to be the same one as received from the interface. 1 -> The truck transport category can be changed manually. 0 -> The truck transport category is set by SAP and cannot be changed in LOGON.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnc_truck_type_bs. Type of the truck: 2-axle ... 5-axle truck or semi-trailer truck.

column.name: TRUCK_TYPE_CD_M_FLAG
column.description: Truck type code mandatory flag: Can the trucktype be changed manually in LOGON truck master data or has it to be the same one as received from the interface. 1 -> The truck type can be changed manually. 0 -> The truck type is set by SAP and cannot be changed in LOGON.

column.name: TRAILER_TRSP_CAT_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_trailer_trsp_cat_bs. E.g. Silo, Container. Logic: Silo -> TRAILER_TYPE_CD needs to be liegend, mehrkammersilo or kippbar. Container -> TRAILER_TYPE_CD needs to be container.

column.name: TRAILER_TRSP_CAT_CD_M_FLAG
column.description: Trailer transport category mandatory flag: Can the transport category be changed manually in LOGON trailer master data or has it to be the same one as received from the interface. 1 -> The trailer transport category can be changed manually. 0 -> The trailer transport category is set by SAP and cannot be changed in LOGON.

column.name: TRAILER_TYPE_CD
column.description: FK tlgnr_trailer_type_bs. E.g. Horizontal (Liegend), Multi chamber Silo, Tiltable (Kippbar), Container..

column.name: TRAILER_TYPE_CD_M_FLAG
column.description: Trailer Type Code Mandatory Flag: Can the trailer type be changed manually in LOGON trailer master data or has it to be the same one as received from the interface. 1 -> The trailer type can be changed manually. 0 -> The trailer type is set by SAP and cannot be changed in LOGON.

column.name: CTL_ACT_CD
column.description: Active Flag. When new data is entered, only reference data with active flag are available for selection normally.
